## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for rotation about the lateral axis in the Euler-angle facet.

### Avoid when

- Avoid Euler angles without [`gmeow:eulerOrder`](gmeow-eulerOrder.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:pitch`](gmeow-pitch.md) with [`gmeow:yaw`](gmeow-yaw.md), [`gmeow:roll`](gmeow-roll.md), and [`gmeow:eulerOrder`](gmeow-eulerOrder.md).

### Examples

- ex:ori [`gmeow:pitch`](gmeow-pitch.md) 0.0; [`gmeow:eulerOrder`](gmeow-eulerOrder.md) "ZYX".
